blocks.etymology: From Middle English travailen, from Old French travailler, from the noun (see above). Doublet of travel. Displaced native Middle English swinken (“to work”) (from Old English swincan (“to labour, to toil, to work at”)).

senses.definition: to work very hard, especially under difficult conditions

examples.en: The farmers travailed all day in the burning heat.
